 Dated this the 8th day of September, 2025
 Order
This bail application is filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS').

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in Crime No.499/2024 of Alathur Police Station, Palakkad,
registered for the offence punishable under Section 420 r/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860.
3. Learned Public Prosecutor, upon instructions, submitted that petitioner has not yet been arrayed as an accused.
It was also submitted that final report has already been filed and that further investigation is going on.
4. In view of the above submission, the apprehension of arrest of the petitioner does not subsist.
Therefore, this bail application is closed.
However, if in case the petitioner is arrayed as an accused in the said crime, and if any coercive proceedings are being initiated against the petitioner

,
necessarily the procedure under Section 35 of BNSS shall be complied with.
